## Client/server compatibility

Complete this section when the client consumes server behavior.

- [ ] I identified whether the feature is core or optional.
- [ ] I checked the latest two stable releases and all stable releases in the
      applicable 14-day optional / 60-day core support horizon.
- [ ] I listed every new route, response field, event, or changed semantic.
- [ ] I recorded the capability/protocol decision and obtained maintainer
      approval.
- [ ] The missing-gate fallback is explicit and makes no unsupported request.
- [ ] Existing advertised capability meanings and older capable fallbacks are
      unchanged, or an approved exception is documented.
- [ ] Newest-client/older-server behavior has automated coverage.
